lead_raw_text:
The structure of CsHg2O3 crystallizes in triclinic symmetry with space group P1, containing six atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Hg and Cs centers, with Hg surrounded by six O neighbors and Cs by six O neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (one Cs, three Hg). The resulting polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Cs and Hg octahedra, and edge-sharing among Hg octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites.
